stem.text: The diagram shows some root cells.

stem.alt: Diagram of three root cells, each with a cell wall, cytoplasm and vacuole, with arrows drawn along a pathway and a key showing an arrow labelled pathway of water moving from the soil.

stem.text: Which statement is correct for the pathway shown by the arrows?

A.text: Water will be blocked by a band of suberin.

B.text: Water will move through the Casparian strip.

C.text: Water will pass easily through the root endodermis.
